data.title: Field Trip Day Routine
data.description: Help organize our exciting field trip schedule by figuring out when each fun thing happens!

challenges.instruction: Pack your backpack and put on your shoes for the big trip!
challenges.hint: Think about what you do right after you wake up.

challenges.instruction: Close your eyes and dream about the animals you saw today.
challenges.hint: When is it time to put on your pajamas and rest?

challenges.instruction: Wash off all the dirt and playground fun in the tub.
challenges.hint: This happens when the sky starts to turn orange after dinner.

challenges.instruction: Ride the big yellow bus back home with your friends.
challenges.hint: Think about what happens when the sun is high up after lunchtime.

challenges.instruction: Eat a yummy breakfast to get energy for the journey.
challenges.hint: What is the very first meal you eat after getting out of bed?
